QUOTE: "No thread is spawned from `library/`." and "The mutex is the wrapper from `threading.c`, which defaults to pthreads (`threading.c:103`) and can be replaced with `THREADING_ALT`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that library/ spawns no threads and that library/threading.c supplies the mutex wrapper used by the modules in a threaded build.
